deployments_detail.use: Just Ask Xero (JAX), an agentic AI business companion (OpenAI-powered) automating invoicing, payment chasing and accounting tasks with real-time insights

JAX (Just Ask Xero), an agentic generative-AI 'financial superagent' that automates accounting tasks, answers business/financial questions, and executes actions/workflows across desktop, mobile, WhatsApp and email. [OpenAI (LLMs served via AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP)]
JAX partnership with OpenAI upgrades JAX into an agentic system able to scan the web and perform deep research to deliver insights to customers. [OpenAI]

Automatic bank reconciliation powered by JAX, using machine-learning algorithms (Rule, Match, Memory, Prediction) to auto-match and reconcile bank statement lines when confidence is high. [Xero (proprietary ML)]

ML-powered bank reconciliation predictions that predict the contact and account code for transactions that cannot be matched to invoices or bills - Xero's first major ML production milestone. [Xero (proprietary ML)]
AI-powered contact predictions using Xero's business register to identify business names in statement lines, based on millions of past data points. [Xero (proprietary ML)]
Xero Analytics AI-driven cash-flow forecasting based on customer payment behaviour, plus AI insights and non-financial operations metrics.

Hubdoc AI/OCR document and data capture - reads key information (supplier names, amounts, invoice numbers, due dates) from bills, receipts and bank statements and turns it into usable accounting data in Xero. [Hubdoc (Xero-owned)]
Generative Answering in Xero Central customer support portal - GenAI surfaces conversational answers to customer support queries for self-service resolution. [Coveo (Relevance Generative Answering)]
deployments_detail.value: 96% of questions answered by Coveo-surfaced content; 40% reduction in average search time; 20% decrease in sessions needing additional support

deployments_detail.use: AI assistant in the Xero support chat (Help menu) that attempts to resolve customer queries immediately before escalating to human support.

Xero MCP Server and AI Toolkit for developers - lets AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) interact with Xero accounting data via Model Context Protocol, OpenAI Agents SDK and LangChain to create invoices, reconcile transactions, and fetch data. [Anthropic Claude / OpenAI / LangChain (MCP)]
Internal engineering use of GitHub Copilot in code editors for technical reviews and executing coding plans, powered by Xero's internal AI platform. [GitHub Copilot]
Integration with Microsoft 365 so JAX can take actions and surface financial answers within Microsoft 365 Copilot, bringing live Xero financial data into M365 apps. [Microsoft 365 Copilot]
